upstream.name: marcelscruz/public-apis
upstream.note: Discovery catalog only. Upstream listing does not guarantee availability, quality, free access, or rights to reuse the APIs or their data.

policy.rule: No browser or server calls are made to listed APIs by this catalog. A live connector requires a separate implementation, owner review of current terms, privacy/security assessment, quotas, timeout, caching and fallback tests.
policy.privacy: Never forward learner identity, access tokens, submissions, personal data or private institutional information to a third-party API unless explicitly necessary, consented, and reviewed.
policy.commercial_use: Verify each provider's current commercial-use rules separately. Public or no-key does not mean unrestricted or free for commercial use.

apis.name: JSONPlaceholder
apis.learning_use: Latihan REST, HTTP methods, JSON, pagination, error handling, and API client tests using fake data.
apis.recommendation: First candidate for API practice because responses are mock data; never use as a production data store.
apis.terms_review: Verify current service policy and usage limits before a public workshop.

apis.name: REST Countries
apis.learning_use: Latihan membaca JSON, filter, mapping data, visualisasi geografi, and comparing country-level indicators.
apis.recommendation: Use only public country data; cache responses and label source/date.
apis.terms_review: Confirm current API version, acceptable use, attribution, rate limits, and dataset terms.

apis.name: Free Dictionary API
apis.learning_use: Vocabulary practice, pronunciation metadata exploration where provided, and building a glossary activity.
apis.recommendation: Do not rely on it as the sole authority for formal language assessment.
apis.terms_review: Confirm current service policy, source dictionaries, and reuse rights before republishing content.

apis.name: Open Library APIs
apis.learning_use: Book discovery, reading lists, metadata search, and information-literacy activities.
apis.recommendation: Show source links and avoid mirroring large datasets or book content.
apis.terms_review: Follow current Open Library API usage guidelines, rate limits, and rights for cover/metadata reuse.

apis.name: Open Trivia DB
apis.learning_use: Prototype low-stakes quizzes and demonstrate JSON parsing and quiz UI.
apis.recommendation: Treat questions as external material; sanitize HTML entities and do not use as validated curriculum or high-stakes assessment.
apis.terms_review: Verify current API limits, attribution, question licensing and commercial-use conditions.

apis.name: Open-Meteo
apis.learning_use: Weather and environmental-data projects involving units, charts, time series, and uncertainty.
apis.recommendation: Useful for science/data-literacy exercises, but not an emergency or safety-critical source.
apis.terms_review: Verify current free-tier scope, attribution, licensing, and commercial-use terms before live use.

apis.name: Public APIs upstream catalog
apis.learning_use: Discover API candidates for project-based learning and compare authentication, HTTPS, CORS, documentation, and terms.
apis.recommendation: Treat entries as leads to verify, not vetted integrations or a runtime dependency.
apis.terms_review: Upstream repository is MIT-licensed; each listed provider's API and data terms remain independent.
